notes.title: Happy Halloween Update! New Jack the Pumpkin Character and Fixes
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween Vegetaball fans! We've been working hard to improve and fix the issues you have brought to our attention.

To celebrate the holiday we created a new playable character Jack the Pumpkin. The pumpkin people only get psychic powers once a year, but Jack has mastered the flow of the seasons and can compete in the Vegedome year-round.

Update v1.03 is now LIVE. There are some minor gameplay changes that mostly affect how platforms function. Here are the patch notes:


 Added Jack the Pumpkin Character
 Increased maximum party size to 8 players
 Added In-game kick player vote system
 Changed the design of how in-game individual player scores are displayed
 Fixed some localization issues on Main Menu UI Elements
 Changed Platform functionality to only raise when player is colliding with platform


Player feedback has really helped our team make this game the best it can be. If you have any suggestions or are aware of a bug please inform us by filling out a ticket here: https://gammagamesinteractive.com/support-center/
